findings: Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot hashes original bytes, parses entries read-only, validates ancestry/references, and detects pending tool calls before conversion.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts completeRewind checks anchor identity and label uniqueness before folding; failed branch write restores the prior leaf and clears the branch label.
Verified: continuity reconciliation protects user-origin rules from agent archival while scoped steering can be archived during fold reconciliation.

Verified: continuity-ledger.ts guardProtected protects user-origin objectives, rules, decisions, and pinned items from agent/classifier mutation; checkCitation enforces a later user-entry citation for protected supersession when indices are known.

Verified: index.ts buildContextMessages freezes the pending rewind projection at instruction entry, so later input is excluded from that projection; README describes late messages being re-appended in order after a successful fold.
Potential risk, not a verified defect: summary-prompt.ts inserts summaryFocus verbatim, although the prompt constrains its role.
Verified: continuity-briefing.ts marks non-user-origin rules, decisions, and objectives as nonbinding and does not drop rules, decisions, or goals to meet a budget.
Verified: continuity-capture.ts stores the user's verbatim message text; the model classifier selects category and superseded IDs.
Potential concern, not a verified defect: auto-navigate.ts forwards model summary_focus verbatim as generated steering, though its output is bounded.

Verified: fold-screen.ts strips terminal controls, labels, and checks minimum-length user words; focus is sent only after explicit confirmation, while leaving the template untouched leaves focus to the agent.
Verified: index.ts planWithhold uses canonical projection membership, skips user/custom/navigation results, and commits no partial drafts if it cannot fit.

Potential risk, not a verified defect: config.ts resolveAutoNavigateConfig short-circuited before remaining behavior on the reported branch; the specific concern is incompletely preserved in the handoff, so it cannot be asserted further without re-reading this completed partition.
